information: #### This competition only features FMC (3x3x3 Fewest Moves) and 3x3x3 Blindfolded As a result, this competition is not recommended for those looking for a typical competition experience. However, new competitors are still welcome to sign up :) Please consider instead any of the many [other competitions happening in Ohio](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). Please note that the Ohio Union requires that all minors be chaperoned by a parent or guardian while outside of the event space. This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBajUwIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--224eff1d3e69f6edef0631f3f44e3b63671ebca7/MCA-Final-Logo%20(WCA%20website%20version).png)
